verdict.rationale: Morph, an API platform rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server at its guides/mcp page. The server lets AI tools such as Claude Code connect to Morph's file editing and expose tools like `codebase_search` and `github_codebase_search`, and the quickstart tells users to install the Morph MCP for Claude Code. Missing for 10: detailed setup/config steps and full tool list in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your favorite AI tools to Morph's blazing-fast file editing via Model Context Protocol.
Install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can read it
